snippet.title: The Cascadier | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Wishlist The Cascadier now on Steam ➤ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3553150/The_Cascadier/

A coin-pusher roguelike with pinball physics! 💥
Build your deck, charge your coins, and send them flying through enchanted machines packed with chain reactions, godly powers, and over-the-top combos.

🎰 Coin-pusher meets deckbuilder chaos
⚡ Charge elemental coins with fire, frost, lightning & more
🌀 Trigger cascading explosions & evolving machines
🌙 Unlock Trinkets, master Fortuna’s machines, and chase Euphoria

The odds are stacked. The coins are charged.
Can you master the cascade?

Visit indie.io on Steam ➤ https://bit.ly/4e91q5q
